headline: Vintage Coffee And Beverages concludes annual general meeting
hook: Annual meeting voting results are now public
summary: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited has submitted the official proceedings and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Such disclosures detail shareholder approvals for routine corporate resolutions and annual business items. Retail shareholders can review the outcome of resolutions on the stock exchange portal. For ordinary investors, routine AGM disclosures have negligible immediate impact on stock price movement.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no direct impact on stock price.
